events.title: FOMC minutes signal another rate hike likely before year-end
events.why_it_matters: September minutes showed a unanimous 25 bp hike and most officials seeing another increase by year-end to fight inflation still well above 2%, reinforcing a higher-for-longer path after the first hike in over three years.
events.what_to_watch: Odds for the Oct 27-28 FOMC (hold vs hike), Fed speeches, and whether December remains the preferred follow-up window.

events.title: US Treasuries spike; 30-year yield hits multi-decade high near 5.70%
events.why_it_matters: The 10-year near 5.3% and 30-year around 5.70% pulled equities off record highs, hit banks and homebuilders, and revived inflation/debt-supply concerns after a $39bn 10-year auction.
events.what_to_watch: Whether yields ease after the auction, curve steepening, and knock-on to mortgages, banks, and duration-sensitive growth stocks.

events.title: Wall Street slips from records as yields and oil rise
events.why_it_matters: Dow fell about 0.66% to ~51,180, S&P 500 and Nasdaq each ~0.22% lower, snapping winning streaks as small-caps and banks lagged; futures were steadier into Oct 8.
events.what_to_watch: Intraday follow-through vs bounce, bank relative performance, and whether oil/yields keep pressuring multiples.

events.title: Brent crude holds above $100 on Middle East risk
events.why_it_matters: Elevated oil feeds inflation and the Fed's hawkish bias while supporting energy producers and pressuring rate-sensitive and consumer names.
events.what_to_watch: Brent staying above $100, gasoline/pass-through, and any escalation that would tighten supply further.

events.title: Russian strikes on Ukraine kill dozens; EU releases €1.24bn for drones and munitions
events.why_it_matters: Missile/drone attacks killed an estimated 20-28 people, Zelenskyy pressed for more Patriots, and Brussels funded Ukrainian drones/munitions, keeping European security and energy-risk premia elevated.
events.what_to_watch: Air-defense deliveries, further EU/US aid, and any spillover into energy infrastructure or NATO posture.

events.title: Israel marks third anniversary of October 7 attacks amid West Bank violence
events.why_it_matters: Commemorations, political controversy over Gaza, and reported settler attacks keep Middle East risk in focus alongside already-high oil prices.
events.what_to_watch: Diplomatic reactions, West Bank escalation, and any disruption to regional energy or shipping.

events.title: Hurricane Isaias threatens US Gulf Coast; Florida emergency for 25 counties
events.why_it_matters: First Atlantic hurricane of 2026 brings rain, surge, and outage risk to a key energy and population corridor, with DeSantis declaring emergencies across 25 counties.
events.what_to_watch: Track/intensity, Gulf energy shutdowns, insured-loss estimates, and retail/utility disruption.

events.title: Trump expands automatic 'Trump accounts' for children born 2025-2028
events.why_it_matters: Automatic enrollment and Treasury seeding for eligible US-citizen children is a long-horizon savings/fiscal signal more than a near-term market mover.
events.what_to_watch: Funding size, eligibility rules, and whether Congress or Treasury operationalizes deposits at scale.

events.title: Weekly jobless claims and other light US data due
events.why_it_matters: Initial claims around 197-200k and continuing claims near 1.70-1.71m are the day's labor pulse after a weak Sept payrolls print (+29k, 4.2% unemployment) on Oct 2.
events.what_to_watch: Claims surprise vs ~200k, wholesale inventories, and EIA gas storage versus the already-soft labor backdrop.

events.title: PepsiCo Q3 2026 earnings before the open
events.why_it_matters: Largest high-profile print of the day (EPS ~$2.29-$2.32, sales ~$25bn) is a read-through on pricing power, volumes, and input costs with oil elevated.
events.what_to_watch: Organic sales, margins, guidance, and any consumer-trade-down commentary ahead of bank earnings next week.

events.title: Southern Cross Acquisition II SPAC listing; major IPOs remain thin
events.why_it_matters: SCAT/SCATR/SCATW is a small SPAC-related listing, underscoring a still-quiet traditional IPO tape rather than a risk-on issuance wave.
events.what_to_watch: Deal pricing/aftermarket and whether larger traditional IPOs reappear if yields stabilize.

events.title: September CPI due Oct 14 after August 3.4% y/y
events.why_it_matters: Next inflation print is the key test of the Fed's hike-again-by-year-end message and of whether oil and yields keep inflation sticky.
events.what_to_watch: Core vs headline, energy pass-through, and market odds for October vs December FOMC.

events.title: Next FOMC decision Oct 27-28; markets lean hold, December hike live
events.why_it_matters: Policy rate is 3.75%-4.00% after September's 25 bp hike; minutes keep another 2026 hike on the table while near-term odds for late October are low (~18-19%).
events.what_to_watch: CPI, claims, oil, and any shift in hike probability into the blackout.

events.title: US bank earnings week begins around Oct 13 (JPM, GS, C, WFC)
events.why_it_matters: Mega-cap banks will show NII, credit quality, and trading against a backdrop of surging long yields and a weaker bank tape.
events.what_to_watch: Net interest income, charge-offs, deposit costs, and commentary on the curve and consumer credit.

events.title: Federal judge earlier ordered restoration of CFPB funding
events.why_it_matters: A court order restoring CFPB funding after challenges to Fed-linked funding limits is a lingering regulatory overhang for consumer-finance supervision, not a fresh Oct 8 ruling.
events.what_to_watch: Appeals, operational restart of CFPB enforcement, and any follow-on Fed-independence litigation.

top_risks: Higher-for-longer rates if CPI stays sticky and the 30-year remains near multi-decade highs
Oil above $100 plus Middle East/Ukraine escalation feeding inflation and risk premia
Hurricane Isaias disrupting Gulf energy, insurance, and regional activity
Bank and housing stress if long yields stay elevated into next week's earnings
top_opportunities: Energy producers and defense if geopolitical premia persist
A rates/equity bounce if claims are benign and yields reverse after the 10-year auction
Select consumer-staples quality if PepsiCo confirms pricing power
Duration and housing relief if October FOMC is confirmed as a hold and CPI cools on Oct 14
summary: On 2026-10-08 markets are digesting hawkish Sept FOMC minutes, a multi-decade spike in long Treasury yields, and $100+ oil while Ukraine strikes, Israel anniversary tensions, and Hurricane Isaias add geopolitical and physical-risk overlays. Near-term data are light (claims, PepsiCo), with the real macro tests still ahead: Sept CPI on Oct 14, bank earnings around Oct 13, and the Oct 27-28 FOMC.
